Table panel for the forest plot

Source: R/table-plot.R
table_plot.Rd

Table panel helper that lays out the tabular labels/CI strings for a forest plot. Each column of tbl becomes a column in the rendered table.

table_plot(
  tbl,
  summary_label,
  ID,
  r = 5.5,
  l = 5.5,
  tbl_titles = NULL,
  text_size,
  y_limit,
  y_breaks,
  y_lines
)

Arguments

tbl

Data frame or matrix of strings to display. One row per item (matching ID), one column per table column.

summary_label

(optional) labeler function created using ggplot2::as_labeller. Labels for group and metagroup.

ID

Numeric vector of y positions corresponding to table rows. Used to align the table with the forest plot.

r, l

parameters corresponding to the plot margin for the confidence intervals.

tbl_titles

Character vector of column headers. If NULL, defaults to names(tbl). Headers may include "\n" for multi-line labels (max 3 lines).

text_size

numeric. Text size for labels. Must be at least 3.5

y_limit

Numeric vector giving the y-axis limits (min, max) for the table panel.

y_breaks

Numeric vector of y-axis breaks.

y_lines

Numeric vector of y positions (where to draw horizontal separator lines).
